description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Lang that manages synchronization between 'lang' and 'xml:lang' attributes in HTML tags, to optimize attribute copying and ensure consistency.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_Lang
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform to copy language attribute values between 'lang' and 'xml:lang'.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the attribute array by copying the 'lang' value to 'xml:lang' if not set, or vice versa, ensuring both attributes are synchronized.
